The point A has coordinates (2, 3) and the point B has coordinates (6, 5).
The point C lies on the line AB.
The point D has coordinates (2, 5.5).
CD is perpendicular to AB.
Find the coordinates of C.
( ...................... , ...................... ) [5]
subject: International Mathematics
